notes:
Patch file to be merged into existing cep_rules.json. Adds HRV suppression, SpO2/PPG perfusion loss, immersion detection, wind-chill/tactile overrides, HR flattening, ALS coverage, water/humidity corroborator, hand-specific skin temp, HR>HRmax guard, and a cold stress additive score + risk tiers.
Merged cold-stress ruleset: adds cold state + override rules, adds hand dexterity/tactile/skin20 overrides, and fixes features.cold.score case ordering for reachability.

Organization: Features are ordered by Cold Stress first (skin temp/hand, wind chill, immersion, perfusion, HRV/SpO2, scoring), then Heart Rate/HRR, then other supporting features. Rules are ordered by Cold Stress overrides, then cold state rules, then cold corroborators, then HR/HRR rules.
merge_instructions: Append all entries in `features` to your existing features array (ensure unique `id`s).
Append all entries in `rules` to your existing rules array.
If an `id` already exists in your file and you prefer our version, replace it; otherwise rename ours with a suffix.

engine._comment: Phase 1: window_tick_ms sets the ring-buffer resolution; rule_eval_interval_ms controls how often rules are evaluated. Both default to 1000ms (1 Hz). Decoupling them is the Phase 5 goal.

features._comment: 20-sample rolling average used as a pre-rise baseline for submerge detection

Difference between recent 5-sample mean and 20-sample rolling baseline. Positive and large when pressure has just risen above a stable ambient level — approximates the PressureService frozen-baseline delta used for submerge detection. A Phase-7 frozen-baseline feature type would give an exact 60 s confirmation.

action.message: Cold Override: tactile failure likely (hand skin ≤ 8°C).
Cold Override: severe peripheral vasoconstriction (hand skin ≤ 20°C).
Cold Stress: hand dexterity impairment likely (hand skin ≤ 15°C).
Rapid cooling with PPG loss — immersion suspected.
HR sustained above HRmax with near-zero HRV — consider HRmax recalibration.
HIGH RESTING HR ALERT — above {features.hr.high_threshold_bpm} bpm
HIGH RESTING HR WARNING — above {features.hr.high_threshold_bpm} bpm
LOW RESTING HR ALERT — below {features.hr.low_threshold_bpm} bpm
LOW RESTING HR WARNING — below {features.hr.low_threshold_bpm} bpm
HRV suppression ≥20% at rest — autonomic strain corroborator.
PPG amplitude collapse >50% — low peripheral perfusion.

rules.description: SpO2 WARN: N consecutive valid readings <= baseline-4% with upper-curve guard.
SpO2 ALERT: N consecutive valid readings <90%.
Rapid pressure rise (>5 hPa over 5 samples) — probable water immersion/dunk. Gated on settings.pressure.immersion_alerts_enabled so the rule respects the user's immersion alert toggle.

action.message: Probable immersion warning — rapid pressure rise detected.

rules.description: Moderate pressure rise (2–4 hPa over 5 samples) — possible shallow immersion. Gated on immersion alerts toggle.

action.message: Possible shallow immersion — moderate pressure rise detected.

rules.description: Sustained pressure elevation ≥5 hPa above the 20-sample rolling baseline — probable prolonged immersion. Approximates PressureService.handleSubmergeDetection() using mean_n5 vs mean_n20; the 5 s sustained window covers the period before mean_n20 fully catches up to the elevated pressure. Phase-7 TODO: replace with a frozen-baseline feature type to support the full 60 s confirmation.

action.message: Probable sustained immersion — pressure held elevated above baseline.

rules.description: Mean atmospheric pressure below configured low threshold for 10 s. Gated on settings.pressure.low_atm_alert_enabled.
